wholeMusclePartRepresentation.familyGeometryComparison: per-source OBJ bounds/vertex ranges and exact source side were checked. Parent matches are interpreted from official FMA/FJ semantic rows and active node IDs; no standalone whole-muscle aggregate FJ for the five target concepts was found in the active parent scene. T102 FJs are emitted once each; sibling parts remain separately identified and are not treated as aggregate meshes. AABB ranges are not used as surface-overlap proof.
wholeMusclePartRepresentation.productRepresentationPolicy: The exact BodyParts3D FJ is the mesh identity: generic, side-specific, and enclosing IS-A semantic rows that reuse an FJ create one node only. Exact candidate/ancestor concepts and their member FJs are recorded; active parent-scene intersections are listed above. No ancestor-only concept is emitted as a second surface; no source bytes are modified.
wholeMusclePartRepresentation.sameFjSemanticRowsPolicy: the FJ is the mesh identity; generic and side-specific IS-A semantic rows that reference one FJ map to one scene node, never one mesh per row
